title: Negotiate a job offer politely (B2)
summary: Cảm ơn, nêu mong muốn dựa trên dữ kiện, đề xuất một con số hoặc điều kiện và giữ quan hệ tốt khi đàm phán offer.
learningObjectives: Bày tỏ sự biết ơn trước khi đề xuất
Nêu mong muốn dựa trên dữ kiện thị trường và kinh nghiệm
Đề xuất một phương án linh hoạt và chốt bước tiếp theo

sections.title: Offer call
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Call: Offer for Backend Engineer, Ridgeway Systems. Recruiter: We are happy to offer you the role at ninety thousand a year, plus the standard benefits. Notes: thank the recruiter, ask for time, state your expectation with evidence, propose a range and keep the tone collaborative.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Sẵn sàng điều chỉnh để hai bên cùng chấp nhận.

performanceTask.title: Make a polite counteroffer
performanceTask.scenario: A recruiter calls with an offer; you thank them, explain your expectation with evidence, propose an option and agree on next steps.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Respond in English for about 90 seconds: thank the recruiter, state your expectation with evidence, propose a flexible option and agree on next steps. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about 90 seconds: thank the recruiter, state your expectation based on evidence, propose a flexible option and agree on the next steps.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Thank you very much for the offer. I am excited about the team and the product, and I would love to join the company. Based on my experience and the market benchmark for this role, I was hoping for a base figure closer to one hundred and five thousand. I have led two major releases and I have mentored three engineers, so I believe that figure reflects the value I can bring in the first year. That said, I am flexible on the structure of the package. For example, I would consider a lower base if we can include a signing bonus or an earlier review after six months. Could we discuss this and find a number that works for both sides? If we can agree on a direction, I am ready to sign this week. When would be a good time to continue the conversation, and who should I speak with about the details? Either way, thank you again for your time and for the trust you have shown in me today.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Respond again in English. Keep the same order and make your evidence more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Negotiate a different offer, such as a lead role with a lower base and larger equity.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Negotiate a new offer without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Four-part response
rubric.description: The response follows thanks, evidence, option and next steps.

anchors.met: All four parts appear in order.
anchors.notMet: A part is missing, such as no next step.

rubric.label: Evidence for the request
rubric.description: The request is based on facts, not feelings.

anchors.met: Cites experience, results or market data.
anchors.notMet: Says "I want more" without a reason.

rubric.label: Collaborative tone
rubric.description: The tone stays friendly and open.
